name: Wood Table Flat-Lay
description: A leather-wrapped notebook resting on a real oak table in warm, raking side-window light — long soft shadows and true wood grain give it the editorial flat-lay energy of an actual desk someone works at, not a studio backdrop.
lighting: Warm raking side-window light, long soft shadows
subject: product
prompt: A leather-wrapped notebook with a brass corner stamped 'Norr & Vale — Field Notebook' staged on a real oak table at a natural 45 to 60 degree flat-lay angle, warm raking side-window light spilling low across the surface in long soft shadows, a leather coaster and a pen resting near the edge of frame, visible wood grain under the raking light with genuine specular highlights and true leather and brass material response, small natural imperfections like a faint water ring nearby, shallow to moderate depth of field keeping the near grain sharp while the far edge of the table softens out of focus, a real lived-in room someone actually works or eats at, no other people, no visible face, no more than two or three supporting objects, no brand text beyond the notebook's own hardware
